title: lodestar-core component diagram
description: lodestar-core, the rules crate: three layers whose dependencies point inward (use cases → features → capabilities). The outer layers that use it (infrastructure, the bridge) are drawn in the game's component diagram.

components.name: lodestar-core
components.responsibility: The deterministic rules, with no engine dependency.

components.name: Use cases
components.responsibility: Fly in a system: the 12 Hz tick and the modes.

components.name: Features
components.responsibility: Docking, the station, hyperspace, spawning, death, the escape pod, the planet and sun, the in-system jump, saving and trading.

components.name: Capabilities
components.responsibility: Random generators, space, ships, the bubble, the pilot, the cockpit, the universe, the market, equipment, flight, combat and the ship AI.

relationships.description: FlyInSystem keeps the cockpit, the bubble and the main generator, and calls combat and flight.
Every feature is built from capabilities; tests/layers.rs forbids the reverse.
